ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly bimodal; the central 55% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity (black) pixels, while the lateral lobes exhibit a mix of high-intensity (white) and mid-tone (mottled) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains high-density, stochastic white speckling on a dark background. Right lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity white patch [approximate coordinates: mid-right to upper-right] containing discrete dark circular nodes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 75-80 degrees, penetrating roughly 30% into the vertical fluke body depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations concentrated on the distal right lobe tip; moderate-frequency jagged peaks are distributed along the superior margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep initiating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve at the mid-point of the lobe, and tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of ~6-8 distinct dark circular rings (likely barnacle attachment points) clustered on the upper-right high-intensity white field and along the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 4-5 parallel, vertically-oriented dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the upper right lobe and one faint horizontal linear disruption on the far left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular scarring and peripheral tissue irregularity on the right distal tip consistent with barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'hook-shaped' pigmentation mark located on the superior margin of the right lobe, approximately 3/4 distance from the notch to the tip.
